data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate had higher overall loss ratios than its Syndicate Business Forecast, with the 2015 year of account suffering deterioration in respect of new claims notified, particularly attritional hull claims.

prior_year_events.impact_description: deterioration in respect of new claims notified, particularly attritional hull claims

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports deterioration on the 2015 year of account driven by new claims notified, particularly attritional hull claims and a cargo concentration. Catastrophe exposure remained low (two larger windstorm claims). No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement amount is stated in the financial notes; therefore a quantified gross prior-year development figure is not available from the report.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate had higher overall loss ratios than its Syndicate Business Forecast, with the 2015 year of account suffering deterioration in respect of new claims notified, particularly attritional hull claims.
The 2016 year of account has experienced higher attritional cargo claims.
Cargo claims were largely influenced by one policy, which has now been cancelled and rewritten with substantially higher pricing and improved terms.
Our exposure to catastrophes has been low, with only two of the larger claims resulting from windstorm damage.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from balance sheet (Claims outstanding prior-year column). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision) is provided in the notes in a single gross figure; only narrative describes a deterioration on the 2015 year and the claims development triangle contains only underwriting years 2015 and 2016 (insufficient older-year columns to compute prior-year development). Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Many monetary tables are reported in GBP 000; amounts converted to millions where indicated.
